candidates.statement: Order service postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool is fully saturated (size 5, idle 0), causing order 503s and gateway checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show pool size 5 with idle 0 at failure time; no pool wait-time or saturation time series was admitted to confirm exhaustion versus slow postgres.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s trace to order service ReadTimeout; order returns 503 with postgres save_order DependencyUnavailable and pool idle=0. Bounded candidate is db-pool-exhaustion; pool wait metrics and postgres health are still needed to confirm.
missing_evidence: Postgres connection pool wait/acquire latency and saturation metrics for order service
Postgres server-side health, latency, and connection count metrics
Order service logs (excluded) to confirm pool-acquisition timeout messages
